evals.prompt: starting a new uniswap v4 hook that skims a 0.1% fee off every swap and sends it to our treasury address. set up the project and write the hook, i want it tested too
evals.expected_output: A Foundry project on the v4-template stack (OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks pinned to commit b5f1057, hookmate, optional Solady) with an afterSwap + afterSwapReturnDelta hook that takes the fee via the unspecified-currency delta, an immutable fee cap, a hookmate-harness test that deploys the hook with deployCodeTo at a flag-encoded address, and a HookMiner deploy script.
expectations: Installs or references OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks at commit b5f1057 and akshatmittal/hookmate, not saucepoint/hookmate
Enables exactly afterSwap and afterSwapReturnDelta (address bits 6 and 2) and leaves every other permission false
Starts from an OZ fee base (BaseHookFee or BaseDynamicAfterFee) or returns the fee as an int128 delta on the unspecified currency, settling it inside the same callback
Bounds the fee with an immutable cap set in the constructor and explains why (hook-fee theft is a documented incident class)
Test deploys the hook with deployCodeTo at an address whose low 14 bits equal the permission flags, then initializes a PoolKey pointing at it
Deploy script mines the CREATE2 salt with HookMiner.find using the same constructor args it deploys with

evals.prompt: poolManager.initialize keeps reverting HookAddressNotValid in my forge test. the hook is deployed with deployCodeTo at address(uint160(Hooks.BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)) and getHookPermissions returns beforeSwap=true, beforeSwapReturnDelta=true, rest false. what's wrong
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis that the address carries only bit 3 while getHookPermissions declares both beforeSwap (bit 7) and beforeSwapReturnDelta (bit 3); a returns-delta flag requires its base flag, so the address must be Hooks.BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG | Hooks.BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG. Should also note the 0x4444 namespace trick and that BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA is bit 3, not bit 10.
expectations: Identifies that the PoolManager validates permissions from the low 14 bits of the hook address, not from getHookPermissions
States that a *_RETURNS_DELTA flag requires its base flag, so bit 3 needs bit 7 set too
Gives the corrected flags expression combining Hooks.BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG and Hooks.BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG
Does not claim BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA is bit 10
Mentions that OZ BaseHook's constructor runs Hooks.validateHookPermissions, so the mismatch would also revert at deploy on a real chain

evals.prompt: write a forge test asserting that a swap reverts with my hook's custom error TradingClosed() when block.timestamp is outside trading hours. vm.expectRevert(MyHook.TradingClosed.selector) isn't matching
evals.expected_output: A test that expects the wrapped revert the PoolManager re-raises: CustomRevert.WrappedError(address(hook), IHooks.beforeSwap.selector, abi.encodeWithSelector(MyHook.TradingClosed.selector), abi.encodeWithSelector(Hooks.HookCallFailed.selector)), with the hook deployed via deployCodeTo and the swap driven through the hookmate router.
expectations: Explains that hook reverts arrive wrapped as CustomRevert.WrappedError, which is why the bare selector does not match
Encodes the expected revert with the hook address, the callback selector, the inner revert data and Hooks.HookCallFailed.selector
Uses vm.expectRevert with the fully encoded wrapped error bytes rather than the inner selector alone
Points to references/testing-and-deployment.md for the exact encoding and fuzz/invariant recipes

evals.prompt: ok hook is tested, deploy it to base mainnet with a forge script. RPC_URL is set
evals.expected_output: A forge script that resolves the PoolManager from hookmate's AddressConstants.getPoolManagerAddress(block.chainid), mines the salt with HookMiner.find against forge-std's CREATE2_FACTORY using the exact constructor args, deploys with new Hook{salt: salt}(...) inside a broadcast, asserts the predicted address, and reminds the user to check the Uniswap routing allowlist.
expectations: Resolves the PoolManager address from hookmate AddressConstants by chain id instead of hardcoding it
Mines the CREATE2 salt with HookMiner.find using CREATE2_FACTORY as the deployer and the same constructor args passed to the deployment
Asserts that the deployed address equals the predicted address after the broadcast
Runs the script with --rpc-url $RPC_URL and a keystore account or signer flag, never a pasted private key
Mentions that unlisted hooks are not routed by the Uniswap interface until the hooksAddressesAllowlist includes them
